purpose.en: Stretch the backs of your thighs.

text.zh: 背部拉长，从髋部向前折
text.en: Keep your back long and fold forward from your hips

text.zh: 双腿伸直并拢，脚尖朝上
text.en: Sit with both legs straight together, toes up.

text.zh: 双手沿腿滑向小腿，拉伸感出现就停
text.en: Slide your hands toward your shins and stop when you feel the stretch.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back to reach the feet.

cautions.zh: 大腿后侧疼痛或发麻时减小幅度，仍不适就停止
cautions.en: Ease off if the back of your thighs hurts or tingles, and stop if it continues.
